summary: Ran the March report on all 180 commits between v2.3.0 and v2.4.0; 9a04783 is the first commit that moves totals from the 2.3.0 values to the 2.4.0 ones, because tally/dates.py now converts to UTC before taking the booking date (reverting only that file restores 2.3.0 totals). Caveat: my 2.4.0 run matches the report on every account except FACILITIES, which is 44.64 lower than the report shows; no commit reproduces that figure.
